slides.s: Engineering Leader | AI-Driven Transformation | 21 Years in Software, DevOps & Security
slides.n: Welcome to {name}'s career journey — a story of 21 years in engineering, from hands-on QA automation to leading AI-powered transformation across global product teams.

items: F5 Innovation India · Jul 2025-Sep 2026 — Led a 10-member team on BIG-IP control plane services, drove multifactor authentication features, security hardening, and agentic AI initiatives that cut upgrade time by ~90% and resolved 100+ long-lived defects and CVEs.

Cisco Systems India · Mar 2020-Jul 2025 — Led architecture and delivery of distributed Webex-Microsoft Teams integration services using Kafka, Redis and Java/TypeScript, plus WebRTC healthcare solutions and AI-driven SDK code generation.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2018-Feb 2020 — Led development of Cisco Expressway serviceability and security fixes, managed CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins/Kubernetes/Docker, and delivered 10+ major and 30+ minor product releases.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2008-Feb 2018 — Led QA and Python-based test automation for Cisco Call Manager and Expressway, mentored QA teams, and drove protocol-level troubleshooting across SIP, H.323, RTP and SDP.
Verizon India & Alcatel India · 2007-2008 — Performed functional and regression testing for IP-converged contact center and Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise PBX solutions.
slides.n: {His} path moved from early QA and test automation roles at Verizon and Alcatel, into deep technical leadership at Cisco, and now into driving agentic AI transformation at F5 — always building high-performing teams along the way.
{His} toolkit blends deep technical skill in Python, Java and cloud-native DevOps with newer expertise in agentic AI, all anchored by strong PMP-certified leadership.
The numbers tell a story of scale and impact — from more than two decades in the industry to cutting upgrade times by 90% and clearing over 100 long-standing defects and CVEs.

{His} foundation spans a classic engineering degree, formal PMP project management certification, and a recent AI postgraduate program from UT Austin — reflecting continuous growth alongside the industry.

slides.h: Driving the Future of AI-Enabled Engineering
slides.n: From QA automation to leading agentic AI transformation, {name} continues to build teams and technology that push engineering excellence forward. Thank you for following {his} journey.
